rules.sentence: Idiopathic Parkinson's Disease (PD): Idiopathic Parkinson's disease consists of Parkinsonism characterised pathologically by neuronal loss with Lewy bodies in the substantia nigra.
Lewy bodies, which are eosinophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions first described by F H Lewy in 1914, are not specific for PD.
Also, Lewy bodies can be found as an incidental finding in elderly patients without clinical features of PD, which probably represent pre-clinical or early stages of PD.
The mean age at onset PD is between 55–65 years, with a slight male predominance of 60%, and mean age of death is 75.5 years.
